adjudication_note: Found by reading all 59 occurrences of `liquidez` before deciding whether to free that surface. The sweep was for one form and surfaced a cluster: the three theories the material gives for the shape of the yield curve — `Expectativas Puras`, `Preferência pela Liquidez`, `Segmentação de Mercado` — a standard exam topic, none of them registered. Reading an instrument's output is where the findings are; running it and reading only the count is how this campaign missed `Exchange` at fragment_share 0.80 for three rounds.

concepts.def: The theory that forward rates are the market's unbiased forecast of future short rates, so the curve's shape is expectation alone.
The theory that longer maturities must pay more because lenders require compensation for giving up liquidity.
The theory that each maturity has its own supply and demand, so rates are set segment by segment.
The mechanism limiting redemptions to a fraction of net assets when liquidity does not meet demand.
The conduct document a participating institution must keep and disclose.
The stated procedure for matching a product to an investor's profile.
The document stating how a manager measures and controls the liquidity of its vehicles.
